data_fields.name: member_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: per-member chance in percent; one roll 0 to 100 per refill (values not read)

data_fields.name: creature_respawn_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: per-creature spawn delay (m_respawnDelay; value not read)

data_fields.name: dynamic_respawn_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: 10.0 (factor = rate / players in zone; applied only when below 1; off by default)

best_idea: A zone population cap that counts dead members until their own respawn is due, refills only at that moment with the due member as the trigger, and uses one chance roll then a random fill, so a zone never exceeds its cap and one death does not bring back a crowd.
decision_why: Row 23 asks for exactly this cap-and-refill shape; the donor keeps the cap as data (a pool row) and the rule in code, and needs no grids or DB tables that Frankendom does not use.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a zone with cap 3 and five members never has more than three counted members (alive or waiting), that a slot refills only when the dead member's respawn time is due, and that in a pool whose only chanced member has chance 100, that member is picked on every refill where it is a candidate.
